layman_headline: Market fear lingers — holding steady while waiting for a cleaner setup.
layman_explanation: The crypto market is in a fearful mood with most coins drifting sideways or slightly down. We already hold two positions — Solana and Chainlink — both slightly underwater but well within their planned risk ranges. The swing trade candidates on offer are either wildly overextended after huge pumps (like Humanity up 100% in a week) or deeply beaten down with no clear catalyst to reverse. There's no compelling reason to add risk right now.
layman_action: Stay patient and hold current positions. Both SOL and LINK are near their entries with intact stop-losses. Wait for a better entry opportunity rather than chasing pumped coins or catching falling knives.
expert_reasoning: The swing candidate list is polarized: one group has already moved 70-155% in 7 days (H, AKE, VELVET, ETHFI) making fresh entries extremely risky for swing trades, while the other group (FET, INJ) is in severe structural downtrends with no technical reversal confirmation — no RSI data, no MACD crosses, no volume breakout signals available. BTC dominance at 56.2% continues to suppress alt performance. Fear & Greed at 34 is improving from 30.3 weekly average but still in Fear territory, suggesting the market hasn't found a bottom worth aggressively buying. Current SOL and LINK positions have defined risk (stops at $69.5 and $8.6 respectively) and reasonable upside targets. Adding a third position without conviction would dilute capital allocation unnecessarily.
risk_factors: BTC dominance rising further could pressure SOL and LINK despite holding above stop-losses
Swan CEO's comment that altcoins are 'basically dead' with a potential BTC bottom in October suggests extended alt pain ahead
CLARITY Act odds collapsing to 10% introduces regulatory uncertainty that could trigger another leg down
watch_list: BTC price action around $63K support — a breakdown below $60K would likely trigger alt sell-offs and our stop-losses
Fear & Greed index trajectory — needs to move toward 40+ to confirm improving sentiment for alt entries
LINK volume and price action near $9.40 — if it reclaims $9.56 entry with volume, the 14.3% 7-day move may have legs to $10.90 target
market_context: The crypto market is in a consolidation phase with BTC at $63K and Fear & Greed at 34. High BTC dominance (56.2%) continues to suppress altcoin performance, while institutional interest (UBS, Paul Tudor Jones) provides a medium-term floor under Bitcoin.
context_banner: Fear-driven market with no clean swing setups — discipline means sitting on hands while existing positions work toward targets.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 34 (Fear) improving from 30.3 weekly avg — sentiment recovering but not yet at levels that historically support confident alt entries.
Swan CEO states altcoins are 'basically dead' with BTC potentially bottoming in October — bearish for near-term alt swing trades.
UBS 24x surge in BTC ETF call options and Paul Tudor Jones increasing IBIT stake signal institutional accumulation, providing a medium-term floor.
All swing candidates lack RSI and MACD data; the parabolic movers (H, AKE, VELVET) show classic overextension patterns making new entries high-risk.
